verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a Python framework for building agents. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: agents, function tools, structured outputs and model-agnostic providers. A developer could use these to construct an insights feature, but that does not count as the product itself delivering in-product, AI-generated insights from the user's data. Nothing in the pack documents a built-in feature that analyzes a user's data and surfaces insights or suggestions, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
